title: ClickFunnels Review (2026)
intro: ClickFunnels is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — ClickFunnels is an all-in-one funnel builder for landing pages, sales funnels, email, and related creator marketing workflows. Published plans: Launch from $97/mo ($81/mo annual), Scale from $197/mo ($164/mo annual), Optimize from $297/mo ($248/mo annual), Dominate from $5,997/yr; free trial marketed. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ClickFunnels when funnel conversion pages and creator all-in-one marketing are the primary job — especially as a Kartra peer.
verdict: Choose ClickFunnels when funnel conversion pages and creator all-in-one marketing are the primary job — especially as a Kartra peer. Compare Kartra for courses/memberships depth, GetResponse for ESP-led funnels, Buffer for social-only jobs, and Marketo for enterprise B2B MAP. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
